body_lead: AI approvals, digital land sale, and massive master plans rolled out CHENNAI: The Tamil Nadu Housing and Urban Development Department has rolled out a series of policy reforms encompassing digital property sales, artificial intelligence–backed single-window approvals, cooperative sector revitalisation, and extensive urban development master plans across the state. Speaking in the Legislative Assembly, Minister for Housing and Urban Development B. Rajkumar outlined targeted initiatives designed to expedite public services, enhance urban infrastructure, and modernise administrative frameworks.
